scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Liquid inventory and phase-dependent nitrogen outflow
entries.method: Request synchronized tank inventory, outflow, inlet/outlet state and valve schedule for each named approach/fill phase with calibration and mass balance.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The phase schedule is an assumed inventory exchange, not a measured expander flow. A different phase duration or thermodynamic state invalidates direct transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Net electrical recovery after losses and auxiliaries
entries.method: Request matched mass throughput, net terminal electrical power, integrated energy and every auxiliary/standby/startup draw on the same time base; record the complete input and output boundary.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Requested round-trip fraction and generator rating are assumptions. Gross shaft power, nameplate rating or isolated efficiency cannot establish net phase output.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Applicability of the existing process-specific recovery ceiling
entries.existing_model_reference: sim/power.js LN2_RECOVERY_KWH_PER_T and its local source comment
entries.units: kWh/t; Pa; K; mol fraction; kg/s
entries.method: Record actual feed/product composition, pressure and temperature, referenced thermodynamic states and the energy boundary; compare applicability with the existing comment-cited process, without recalculating its ceiling.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The declared process comparator is a model ceiling, not a universal recoverable value or measured airborne expander. A mismatched state or uncounted heat source leaves applicability UNKNOWN.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Heat exchanger, cooling and ambient interfaces
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md cryogenic evaluator questions and ambient-pressure cooling question
entries.units: W heat; K; Pa; kg/s; kg; m2
entries.method: Request matched heat duties, thermal approaches, pressure drops, fluid/ambient states, exchanger and duct/coolant/support inclusions across startup, steady and transient use.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Ground-plant mass or power comparators with supplied cooling omit part of the airborne installation; no exchanger or heat-source design is selected here.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Complete expander and supporting equipment mass
entries.method: Request itemized actual expander, heat exchanger, plumbing, controls, insulation, support and conditioning records with component lots and explicit inclusion/exclusion boundaries.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The published mass-budget comparators are not a complete matched expander installation. Missing auxiliaries/support or a different plant/output basis prevents a direct mass comparison.

entries.units: V; A; W; s; Hz; K
entries.method: Request synchronized terminal voltage/current/power, recovery ramp, converter limits, battery acceptance, rotor/other loads and trips at the same phase and atmosphere; retain response and uncertainty records.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Static phase power caps and averaged bus inputs do not establish transient regulation or simultaneity. Missing actual bus criteria remain UNKNOWN and cannot be replaced by numerical closure tolerances.
